programme.title: Crikey! It's Shark Week
programme.desc: Robert Irwin comes face to face with a great white shark for the first time with shark conservationists Paul de Gelder and Madison Stewart following in his father's footsteps, he will get as close as possible to these incredible creatures.

programme.title: The Zoo: A New Beginning
programme.desc: Max the Camel faces new challenges as he ages the Zoo prepares to give an injured turkey vulture a permanent home, but after healing, there may be a change of plan Willow the Red Panda gives birth to two baby cubs.

programme.title: Dogs: The Untold Story: Survival of the Friendliest
programme.desc: A look at how dogs have evolved from wild predators to friendly pets features parts of the world where dogs are spoiled as much as children.

programme.title: I Was Prey: Night Stalker
programme.desc: A black bear charges Joe Azzouggagh and his German shepherd, Ace, deep in the Ontario wilderness single father Andrew Dickehage, forced to walk six miles along a rural road at night, comes under attack from unseen predators.

programme.title: Crikey! It's the Irwins: Road Trip Rescue
programme.desc: Carrying three baby kangaroos and an emu, the Irwins caravan into the Australian Outback to release the animals on Mourachan, their giant wildlife conservation property plans shift when they discover more animals in need of rescue along the way.

programme.title: Treetop Cat Rescue: Cat Scratch Fever
programme.desc: Tom tries to reunite the not-so-sweet, Cake with its owners Tom rescues a cat that will not let go of him in Burien.

programme.title: Carter's W.A.R.: One Rhino at a Time
programme.desc: While visiting a secret orphanage that cares for rescued baby rhinos, Ivan discovers the blood, sweat, tears that go into saving this endangered species. An emergency phone call sends him on an adventure with a group of local heroes.

programme.title: Lair of the Great White
programme.desc: A team of experts attempts to find out why a population of great whites off the coast of Western Australia is so much more aggressive than others the team braves the elements and ventures into treacherous underwater caves to find out for themselves.
